text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Diamond Stakes, and a fan approaches us outside the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the reporter in the round glasses we met at the academy. He praises Tannhauser's optimism and tells her that her words saved him.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the support of many different people pushing her forward, it's time to challenge the Diamond Stakes!
